verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state admins can control which MCP servers developers can access via allow lists, group tools into toolsets to enable/disable, and enforce governance via audit logs and a single control plane for agents — directly matching the engineering-lead's need to control external tool/integration access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the admin allow-list enforcement in practice, and finer detail on per-agent (vs per-org) granularity.
